summary: Apply the abstract filling lemma (Fits.exists_translate_finrank_comap_le) to the principal representation of 𝖦_D on principalForms(D, Y₀(D)) (restricted scalars), Q = 𝒫_D·columnCoords⁻¹-coordinates (Petersson products = vol(level)·amplitude sums, petersson_poincare) and the good-label idempotents g_i (bad share ≤ b⁻⁸/2 by bad_share_le), with the rank bound finrank_rows_le_mass: some translate keeps (1 + φ + 19b⁻⁴)/2 of the coordinates outside F. Composing with c·ramifyingOp costs #piPlaces·(N − 1)⁻¹·dim Column ≤ … in the preimage, and 19/2·b⁻⁴ + #piPlaces/(N − 1) ≤ b⁻² by the sizes of the data.

steps.claim: b(D)⁹ ≤ N(D) − 1 (a size comparison of the data, le_of_hasLogBound, rewritten with le_sub_iff_add_le), recorded as a lower bound for N(D) − 1 on the logarithmic scale (hasLogLower_of_le).

h: the abstract filling lemma for ρ = the principal representation of 𝖦_D (as a representation on the ℂ-space principalForms(D, Y₀(D))) and Q = poincareMap of filling_fits(D) on ℓ²(Classes × BesselCoord), with c = vol(stdPrincipalLevel): ρ is unitary (inner_formRep); ⟨ρ(s)Qe_y, Qe_x⟩ = c·amplitudeSum(S, G(E), x.1, s, y.1)(x.2, y.2) (petersson_poincare, s lifted through liftResidue); each g_i = ∑_{good tuples} tupleIdem is a central idempotent; Re(1 − g_i)(1) ≤ f·(1 + M_ω + 2r)/q + e^{−9 log b(D)} by bad_share_le with ε = (1 + M_ω + 2r)/q and L = 9·log b(D) (#𝔽_w = q = g_i(D), r = #RowIndex(D), f = #chosen places above g_i; the side conditions 1 < r < q, ε ≤ 1 and 2r(2r·log q + 1)L ≤ f are size comparisons of the data), and this is ≤ b(D)⁻⁸/2 by another size comparison; and c > 0 (measureReal_pos_of_isLevel).
steps.lean:
have h := Fits.exists_translate_finrank_comap_le (ρ :=
    .comp (D.principalRep _) (.mk' _ (by tauto))) (fun _ _ _ ↦ Space.inner_formRep ..) (fun _ ↦
    (D.filling_fits.petersson_poincare · · (@reduceFamily_liftResidue ..))) (fun _ ↦
    isCentralProj_sum_tupleIdem) (fun i ↦ (bad_share_le (M := P.Mω D.s) (q := D.g i) _ (9 * D.logB)
    (card_resField_eq_levelPrime _ i) rfl (card_chosenPlaces _ i) D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound
    D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound D.le_of_hasLogBound le_rfl D.le_of_hasLogBound).trans
    (filling.eq_1 D ▸ D.le_of_hasLogBound)) (measureReal_pos_of_isLevel (K := D.chosenLevel))

steps.claim: In h, identify ρ(⊗_i g_i) with the image of e₀(D) (a side goal, steps 7–8), 𝔰.r with #RowIndex and the index set of 𝖦 (Σ-type of the chosen places) with that of 𝖦_D (piCurry).
steps.lean:
erw [(?_ : Representation.asAlgebraHom _ _ = (principalRep ..).asAlgebraHom D.e₀), Shape.r,
    card_rowIndex, ← Nat.card_congr (.piCurry _)] at h

steps.claim: Unfold IsSpread in h and transport the dimensions of preimages and of Column(D) through the linear isomorphism columnCoords(D) (finrank_eq).

For a subspace F of rows(D): h with the rank bound finrank_rows_le_mass gives s with dim (Rρ(s)Q)⁻¹F ≤ ½(1 + φ + 19b⁻⁴)·dim Column; then dim B_s⁻¹(F) ≤ dim (c·ramifyingOp)⁻¹((Rρ(s)Q)⁻¹F) (the preimage under the scaled operator equals the preimage under ramifyingOp, simpa) ≤ dim (Rρ(s)Q)⁻¹F + #piPlaces·(N − 1)⁻¹·dim Column (ramifyingOp_finrank_comap_and_short).
steps.lean:
refine fun F ↦ (h D.finrank_rows_le_mass F).imp' Sigma.uncurry fun _ h ↦
    .trans (mod_cast finrank_mono fun _ ↦ by simpa using!
    id) (((D.ramifyingOp_finrank_comap_and_short .univ _).1.trans (add_le_add h le_rfl)).trans ?_)

steps.claim: The constants: ½(1 + φ + 19b⁻⁴) + #piPlaces(D)·(N − 1)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + φ)/2 + b⁻²; after simp (#piPlaces = card_piPlaces, the definition of filling) and gcongr this is a comparison of sizes of the data (le_of_hasLogBound), using N − 1 ≥ b⁹.
steps.lean: simp [← add_mul, add_assoc, card_piPlaces, filling]; gcongr; use D.le_of_hasLogBound

steps.claim: The side goal ρ(⊗g_i) = ρ(e₀(D)): expand asAlgebraHom as a sum over the group and reindex by piCurry;

then e₀(D) = ∑_{good tuple families} tupleIdem, and the product over the chosen places of the sums over good tuples is the sum over families of the products (prod_univ_sum, prod_sigma): both sides are the same element.
steps.lean: simp [e₀, goodTupleFamilies, tupleIdem, Finset.prod_univ_sum, Fintype.prod_sigma]; rfl
